overview: A comprehensive chronic absenteeism tracking dashboard for Jefferson Middle School (650 students, grades 6–8). Features interactive charts, grade filters, trend analysis, accountability tracking, role-based views, reporting, and an audit log — all optimized for desktop and mobile.
features: Summary cards for today's attendance rate, chronic absences, and newly flagged students
Grade filter buttons updating all charts and tables in real time
Line chart for daily attendance rate and bar chart for chronic absenteeism by grade
Sortable, searchable student table with trend arrows and milestone badges
Student detail panel with navigable attendance calendar
Alert system with notification bell, dismiss, and parent letter modal
Accountability tracking: letter-sent timestamps, notes per student, days since last contact
Early warning: trend arrows and predictive flags for at-risk students
Reporting: monthly summary, month-vs-month comparison, homeroom breakdown
Role switcher (Principal/Teacher) filtering data to homeroom
Audit log of all actions with timestamps
